test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In an election between two candidates 80% of the registered voters cast their vote and 15% of the votes polled were found invalid. The winning candidate got 60% of the valid votes and won the election by a margin of 1394 votes. How many voters were registered?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Winning margin = (60% − 40%) = 20% of the valid votes.

Total Voters × 80% × (100% − 15%) × 20% = 1394

⇒ Total × 0.8 × 0.85 × 0.2 = 1394

⇒ Total × 0.136 = 1394

⇒ Total = 1394 ÷ 0.136 = 10250

**∴ The correct answer is 10250 voters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Voted = 80% of registered, Invalid = 15% of polled votes.

Winner = 60% of valid votes, Margin = 1394 votes.

⇒ Let the total number of registered voters be 100u.

⇒ Votes polled = 80% of 100u = 80u

⇒ Invalid votes = 15% of 80u = 12u

⇒ Valid votes = 80u − 12u = 68u

⇒ Winner's votes = 60% of 68u = 40.8u

⇒ Loser's votes = (100% − 60%) of 68u = 40% of 68u = 27.2u

⇒ Winning Margin = 40.8u − 27.2u = 13.6u

⇒ Given, 13.6u = 1394 ⇒ u = 102.5

⇒ Total registered voters = 100u = 100 × 102.5 = 10250

**∴ The correct answer is 10250 voters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Valid Votes Base

In election problems, percentages secured by the candidates are typically calculated on the total valid votes unless specifically stated as a percentage of total registered voters.

Successive Percentage Change

When events occur sequentially (e.g., total → voted → valid), the ultimate value is found by multiplying all the respective fractional factors to the original base.
